name: Zi Juan
parentage: A clonal selection from a natural purple-leaf mutation of C. sinensis var. assamica.
description: 'Purple Juan'. A unique and modern Yunnan cultivar developed from a natural purple-leaf mutation of the Da Ye (Assamica) varietal. Its most striking feature is its deep purple leaves, buds, and stems, a result of a very high concentration of anthocyanins. The finished tea has a distinct flavor profile, often with berry-like and slightly medicinal notes.
plantType: Upright, medium-sized bush with a striking purple coloration throughout the plant (Camellia sinensis var. assamica).
environment: Grown in the high-altitude tea regions of Yunnan, where strong sunlight is thought to enhance its purple pigmentation.
processing: Processing Zi Juan requires care to manage its higher-than-average astringency and bitterness. The processing method (green, black, or Pu'er) dramatically changes its final flavor profile.
oxidation: Oxidation levels can vary from none (green/Pu'er) to full (black tea). Full oxidation can help to mellow some of its natural astringency.
roasting: No roasting is typically applied. Like Pu'er, it is often sun-dried for green tea styles, or oven-dried for black tea styles.
versatility: Moderately versatile. It can be crafted into several different types of tea, but its unique and assertive flavor profile means it will always be a niche, specialty product rather than a mainstream tea.

china: Yunnan Province (various regions, often as a specialty crop)

Green Tea.Purple Needle: A sun-dried green tea (similar to Sheng Pu'er processing) that highlights its unique briskness and color.

Black Tea.Purple Black: A fully oxidized tea that has a unique reddish-purple liquor and a fruity, slightly astringent flavor.

Pu'er Tea.Purple Pu'er: Can be pressed into cakes like traditional Sheng Pu'er, valued for its unique character and appearance.

sensory.flavor: Noticeably astringent and sometimes bitter, with fruity notes reminiscent of purple berries and a slightly medicinal finish.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Brisk and astringent with a unique mouthfeel. The liquor has a fascinating color, often greenish with purple or reddish hues.
